后台任务在推进（r/SaaS 已拿到，还有 6 个 sub）。等它跑完，同时抓 Gumroad 和 AppSumo 榜单。

[tool-call run_code] {"timeoutMs": 300000, "code": "
const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
 "const http=require('http');",
 "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
 "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36';",
 "function get(u){return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){",
 " const pu=new URL(u);",
 " http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':'text/html'}},function(res){",
 " const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
 " res.on('end',function(){resolve({status:res.statusCode, body:Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8')})});",
 " }).on('error',reject);",
 "});}",
 "(async function(){",
 " // Gumroad discover: 提取产品名和价格",
 " const r=await get('https://gumroad.com/discover?sort=best_selling');",
 " console.log('gumroad status', r.status, 'len', r.body.length);",
 " // 找 JSON-LD 或 product 数据",
 " const names=[...r.body.matchAll(/\"name\":\"([^\"]{5,80})\"/g)].map(function(m){return m[1]}).slice(0,40);",
 " console.log('names sample:', JSON.stringify(names.slice(0,25)));",
 " const prices=[...r.body.matchAll(/\"price_cents\":(\\d+)/g)].map(function(m){return Number(m[1])/100}).slice(0,30);",
 " console.log('prices sample:', JSON.stringify(prices.slice(0,25)));",
 " console.log('');",
 " await new Promise(function(x){setTimeout(x,5000)});",
 " // AppSumo",
 " const a=await get('https://appsumo.com/');",
 " console.log('appsumo status', a.status, 'len', a.body.length);",
 " const deals=[...a.body.matchAll(/\"name\":\"([^\"]{5,70})\"/g)].map(function(m){return m[1]}).slice(0,30);",
 " console.log('deals sample:', JSON.stringify(deals.slice(0,20)));",
 "})();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-gr.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-gr.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Extract Gumroad and AppSumo product data", timeoutMs: 260000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text).slice(0, 6000) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 2000));

  "  console.log('deals sample:', JSON.stringify(deals.slice(0,20)));",
  "})();",
].join("\n");
